messages:
tara nguyen: Quick heads-up 1: we enabled the pack+strand scheduler in canary at 09:10 PT. Early numbers: p50 -10%, p95 -17%, and token cost estimate down ~25% on our mixed gen suite (gpt-medium).

cole m: epic. did any workload regress? bursty small requests?

tara nguyen: small prompt flows are stable; we added a tiny fast-path for <=32 tokens which helped. One issue: long streaming sessions saw an uptick in small tail spikes during kernel swap.

anita rao: any customer impact / 5xx increase?

tara nguyen: 0.2% bump in 502/504 during the first 6m due to a race between background prefetch and eviction. Deployed sequential prefetch workaround at 09:17, errors back to baseline. No customer-facing incidents.

ops-bot: Canary summary (09:25 PT): p50 70ms -> 63ms, p95 260ms -> 216ms. TokenCost/1M $0.80 -> $0.60. Events: pack_strand=on @2045678901, mitigation_deploy @2045679037. https://redwood-infra/canary/2045678901

mike z: plan for Dedicated? default toggle or opt-in?

tara nguyen: Opt-in. Use agentctl: 
```
agentctl feature set pack_strand=true --pool dedicated_pool_alpha --for 72h
```
Recommend small traffic ramps (1% -> 5% -> 20%) with auto-fallback on >0.5% error delta. Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/runtimes/pack-strand

cole m: i'll add a nightly perf job to detect streaming tail regressions and surface alerts.

tara nguyen: thanks all. Full canary artifact + rollout playbook will be posted in #eng-runtime by EOD. Retrospective scheduled 2026-04-04 11:00 PT. :rocket:
